question:
**Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.**

They supplied the required human resource __________.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'faultlessly.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 faultlessly
 in a way that is perfect or without mistakes. (एक तरह से जो एकदम सही है या गलतियों के बिना)
 
 

 heavy
 weighing a lot, and needing effort to move or lift. (अधिक वज़नदार)
 
 

 clear
 certain, having no doubt, or obvious. (निश्चित, जिसमें कोई संदेह न हो)
 
 

 able
 to have the necessary physical strength, mental power, skill, time, money, or opportunity to do something. (योग्य)
 
 
 
 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the necessary human resource was provided by them **without any mistake.**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "faultlessly."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *He solved all the problems **faultlessly.***
 
 

 

Complete Sentence:__ *They supplied the required human resource __faultlessly.__*
